name: USAFA Flyby Cubing 2023

venue.name: Arnold Hall, USAFA
venue.address: 2308 Cadet Dr, Air Force Academy, CO 80840, USA
venue.details: Competition will be held in the Arnold Hall Ballroom

information: All competitors **must** read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww?si=gDUqZuhvCmV9hL8O) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitot tutorial at 8:00 AM. **Important:** To access the Air Force Academy, every person over the age of 18 **must** show some form of government issued ID. More information can be found under the Travel tab. Note: Competitors with a non-US citizenship and a foreign passport may have trouble getting on base.
